project.name: Beta 2 · aligned
project.title: Beta 2 · intermediates on the centre line
project.blurb: Two Ø19 discs on Dual_Dial_Concept's dial centres, the movement centred on them, set by a crown at 3 o'clock on the movement, between the swivel lugs. The crown's worm turns a small crown arbor whose wheel turns the minute pinion; the train runs on above and below the centre, the two intermediates on one line through the middle: minute pinion 13 → wheel 33, pinion 14 → wheel 28, pinion 11 → hour wheel 26 (exactly 12:1), so the discs keep true time against each other. 10.4 crown turns an hour. Module 0.6 (the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space), black delrin throughout, brass rods, bearings showing like jewels. Movement 44.5 x 42.2 mm, 13.6 mm from the back of the plates to the top of the discs.
source: Claude, 2026-11-23, from Adam's brief: the watch version of Hemistitch, hand-set, discs centred on the movement, crown at 3 o'clock on the movement to clear the hinged lugs, standard movement layering with the guts on show, a reliable machining tolerance; the case scaled to fit afterwards. Layout from a search over every rod, bearing, gear layer, the worm and the stem, scored on the box centred on the discs.

focus.label: Crown → E → minute → first and second intermediate → hour

rules.why: module 0.6: the 0.5 mm end mill has room in every tooth space

shop.note: black delrin throughout; fits are delrin placeholders until the press-fit test

arbors.name: Minute arbor
arbors.role: Turns once an hour; carries the minute disc. Its 13-tooth pinion takes the crown (from E's wheel) and drives the first intermediate wheel. Runs in plain delrin holes (under the disc), so the worm can lie close beside its rod.

arbors.name: First intermediate

partNames.a1: First intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: Above the centre, between the discs. Its 33-tooth wheel is driven by the minute pinion; its 14-tooth pinion drives the second intermediate. One piece of 1/8" delrin, milled from the pinion side.

arbors.name: Second intermediate

partNames.a2: Second intermediate wheel and pinion (one piece, 1/8" delrin)

arbors.role: Below the centre, between the discs. 28:14 down from the first intermediate; its 11-tooth pinion drives the hour wheel 26:11. One piece of 1/8" delrin; four arms.

arbors.name: Hour arbor
arbors.role: Turns once in 12 hours; the hour disc sits right on its wheel (riding high on the second intermediate pinion so the disc clears it).

arbors.name: Crown arbor (E)
arbors.role: Takes the crown: the worm on the stem turns its 12-tooth worm wheel (in a pocket in the lower plate), and its 15-tooth wheel turns the minute pinion. Runs in plain delrin holes. One crown turn = one tooth: 10.4 turns an hour.

hands.name: Hour disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, numerals V-carved and filled. Sits right on the hour wheel. Turns the other way to the minute disc (three reductions).

hands.name: Minute disc
hands.role: Ø19 black delrin, V-carved and filled; on the minute rod at the hour disc's height.

plate.name: Bench
plate.role: Just the bench under the movement; the plates are the drawn parts.
